title: Wheel Impact Load Detector (WILD) Overview & Passenger System Case Study- A Progressive Railroading DemoCast
summary: On August 25, 2026, Jacob Capra, Product Manager - WILD, presented L.B. Foster's WILD IV solution during a Progressive Railroading DemoCast.
body_markdown:
The session, *"Wheel Impact Load Detector (WILD) Overview & Passenger System Case Study,"* explored the latest applications of the[WILD IV System](https://lbfoster.com/rail/total-track-monitoring/wheel-impact-load-detector) , including:


-


An overview of Wheel Impact Load Detection technology


-


Real-world rail industry applications and historical use cases


-


Passenger agency alarm trends and performance insights
